test.command: cargo llvm-cov nextest -p printobserver-sdk --no-report --no-tests=pass -E 'not binary(integration) and not binary(live) and not binary(falsifying)'

test-integration.command: cargo nextest run -p printobserver-sdk --no-fail-fast --test-threads=1 -E 'binary(integration) or binary(live) or binary(falsifying)'
